description.zh:
指定任务启动所在区域，取值：
- ap-southeast-1（新加坡）
- ap-southeast-5（印度尼西亚）
- cn-beijing（北京）
- cn-shanghai（上海）
description.en:
The region where the task is launched. Valid values:
- ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
- ap-southeast-5 (Indonesia)
- cn-beijing (Beijing)
- cn-shanghai (Shanghai)

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询拉流转推任务。
- 支持查询指定ID的任务配置信息和状态信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Call this API operation to query a pull-to-push streaming task.
- Supports querying the configuration information and status information of a task with a specified ID.

## QPS Limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 10 calls per second. Exceeding the limit will result in API throttling, which may affect your business. Please call this API appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-pull-to-push --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id fd245384-4067-4f91-9d75-9666a6bc0000 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
